|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' (this page): '''First published 19 February 2021''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainherasyndulla_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-Light91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.png (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Kirdo III Operative”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. If with an Imperial (or two Rebels), adds one battle destiny. During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Rebels here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.” This image was first published on 19 February 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainherasyndulla_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb]); the card-size GIF uploaded 23 June 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b160bc3511d221ce14e57009aff2b36a62f5c004 commit b160bc3], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). On 19 February 2021 the PC re-uploaded this image as a 745×1039-pixel GIF<ref name="img-Light3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> ([[:File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2021-02-19.gif]]). Scaled to the same size, it is the same image, with the same corners, border, credit line, picture, words and mark; only the size and file format differ. A re-hosted copy is a note on the printing it shows, not a separate version (Bill, 25 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-Light793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' small re-rendering differences in the image (visible when zoomed; see the crops); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Kirdo III Operative”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. If with an Imperial (or two Rebels), adds one battle destiny. During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Rebels here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainherasyndulla_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-Light12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the Players Committee logo (“SWCCG Players Committee”) now prints at bottom right, left of “(AI)”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Kirdo III Operative”. It is the current image. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. If with an Imperial (or two Rebels), adds one battle destiny. During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Rebels here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.”
